name: facade-file-download
title: Facade gRPC file download (GetMessageFile + DownloadFile)
description: Expose Telegram file download through the facade gRPC surface: additive GetMessageFile (message to downloaded local path) and DownloadFile (file_id to local path) RPCs, wired through app/facade and infra/telegram following the existing clientAdapter/Repo pattern. No byte streaming, no progress updates, no existing-RPC changes.
scope: facade gRPC surface + app/facade + infra/telegram passthrough; no engine/ruleset/GraphQL change
creator: killbus
